_comment: Source strategy config. EVERY URL here is a starting hint marked verify:true — Phase P03 must smoke-test each (HTTP 200, parses as RSS/Atom, has dated items) and DISABLE the ones that fail rather than ship broken sources. Never scrape LinkedIn or X/Twitter (ToS + fragile).

fetch.user_agent: VCIntelBot/1.0 (fundraising research tool; contact via APP_BASE_URL)

query_templates: "{firm}" (logistics OR "supply chain" OR freight OR fleet OR warehouse OR "last-mile") when:30d
"{firm}" (invests OR invested OR backs OR led OR announces OR interview OR podcast OR keynote OR panel) when:30d
google_news_rss.note: Result links are Google redirect URLs: resolve to the publisher URL before fetching. `when:30d` is a hint only — still validate dates ourselves.

also_look_for: podcast RSS linked from the site

independence_rules.independent_source: distinct registrable domain AND not a near-duplicate of another source's text (>=0.85 shingle similarity => same underlying copy) AND not a known syndicator re-run
independence_rules.same_event_cluster: same vc_id + same normalized subject_entity + same signal_type family + event dates within 7 days

date_resolution_ladder: 6. Explicit date stated in text and extracted by Gemini (explicit_in_text)
7. Nothing => DATE_UNVERIFIED => candidate cannot become a signal
NEVER use dateModified, fetch time, or 'today' as the event date.

optional_search_apis._note: Raw-results-only. NEVER call their built-in 'answer'/LLM endpoints: all AI tasks must be Gemini. Tavily: topic=news, days=30, include_answer=false. Exa: type=auto/neural search with startPublishedDate, no 'answer' endpoint.
